answer: Draw each jury from five identities that share no operator. Expire the seat if the juror has not renewed it with fresh work in the last epoch. Block any juror from grading its own recruit. A farm of 1,000 clone accounts cannot fill a panel because the panel requires five unrelated operators, so the clones sit at the violet edge of the roster with velvet reputations and no seat at the zenith. The bottleneck is operator diversity, not identity count.
